papers.title: BioMedArena: An Open-source Toolkit for Building and Evaluating Biomedical Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract: Building a deep research agent today is an exercise in glue code: the same backbone evaluated on the same benchmark can report different accuracies in different papers because harness and tool registry all differ, and integrating a new foundation model into a comparable evaluation surface costs weeks of model-specific engineering. We call this the per-paper engineering tax and release BioMedArena, an open-source toolkit that alleviates it and provides an arena for fair comparison of different foundation models when evaluating them as deep-research agents. The toolkit, configurations, and per-task traces are available at https://github.com/AI-in-Health/BioMedArena.

papers.title: From flat to narrow bands: Engineering quantum emission in a one-dimensional Lieb lattice
papers.abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for engineering quantum emission in structured photonic environments.
